post.description: Runs on the AI worker. The file takes one N×C×H×W input named `input` (values 0 to 1, any batch, height and width in steps of the model's patch multiple) and returns `output`. Download it from `GET /runs/{run_id}/onnx` once the job succeeds.

get.summary: The model catalog and what is installed

schema.title: Response List Models Api Models Get

post.summary: Download, verify and install a model
post.description: Idempotent: an installed model returns with `job: null`; a download in progress returns its job.

post.summary: Add your own ONNX model (raw request body)
post.description: Send the .onnx file as the request body. A job runs the model on test images to find its scale, size step, output range and speed, then adds it to AI Lab and Flows. Same-size models are listed under `task` (denoise by default); models that enlarge are always upscalers. At most 1024 MB, one file (no external data).

calibrated.title: Calibrated
calibrated.description: True when the tile size comes from memory measured on this GPU.

device.title: Device
device.description: `cpu` forces the CPU even with a GPU.

restore_faces.title: Restore Faces
restore_faces.description: After upscaling, restore faces with GFPGAN (it must be installed).

mask.description: For erase: brush strokes over what to remove, in image-relative units.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The first characters of the key, to tell keys apart.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: The key itself. It is shown only this once.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The first characters of the key, to tell keys apart.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: The image this one was made from by an AI run.

derivation.title: Derivation
derivation.description: How an AI result was made.

faces.title: Faces
faces.description: Faces found; null until counted, -1 if the image couldn't be checked.

score.title: Score
score.description: Search or similarity score, when searching.

signed_in.title: Signed In
signed_in.description: True when this request carries a valid key, or keys are off.

crop.title: Crop
crop.description: Side of each high-resolution crop, in pixels.

val_every.title: Val Every
val_every.description: One image in this many is kept for validation.

blur.description: Gaussian blur sigma, in pixels; 0 is off.

noise.description: Noise sigma on a 0 to 255 scale.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups to resolve; leave out to resolve every group.

EditDocumentIn.title: EditDocumentIn
EditDocumentIn.description: Validated against the operation catalog on save; see GET /api/ops.

FlowFileIO.title: FlowFileIO
FlowFileIO.description: A flow saved as a file (`.flow.json`), for sharing and for `siqe run`.

ai.title: Ai
ai.description: Whether any block runs an AI model.

output_folder.title: Output Folder
output_folder.description: Where this run's files are on your computer.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Try it on the first images without changing the Library.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: 0 for the input, 1 for most blocks, 2 for 'two or more'.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in AI Lab; a version number is added.

onnx.title: Onnx
onnx.description: The last ONNX export of the best checkpoint: step, size, exporter and the largest difference from PyTorch measured after exporting; `url` downloads it.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Size relative to the input, e.g. '1', '1/2' or '3'.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Output size ÷ input size; null until the graph is valid.

train_memory_mb.title: Train Memory Mb
train_memory_mb.description: Estimated GPU memory to train at batch 16, patch 64.

patch_multiple.title: Patch Multiple
patch_multiple.description: Training patches must be a multiple of this (from Down blocks).

context.title: Context
context.description: Input pixels each output pixel sees on each side (for tiling).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the folder is checked on a schedule.

available.title: Available
available.description: Whether the folder was found at the last check.

files.title: Files
files.description: Image files found at the last check.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How the list was made: browsing, search by description, by name only, or similar.

search_model.title: Search Model
search_model.description: Install state of the CLIP model behind search.

faces_ready.title: Faces Ready
faces_ready.description: Whether the face detector (part of the face restoration model) is installed.

faces_pending.title: Faces Pending
faces_pending.description: Images whose faces haven't been counted yet.

model_id.title: Model Id
model_id.description: The id the model will have once the check passes.

job.description: The job that checks the file and adds the model.
The download job; null when the model was already installed.

calibrated.title: Calibrated
calibrated.description: Devices this model has measured its memory use on.

source.title: Source
source.description: forge: a model you trained and published from Forge. user: an ONNX file you added.

benchmark.title: Benchmark
benchmark.description: For Forge models: PSNR, SSIM and speed measured when it was published.

probe.title: Probe
probe.description: For ONNX models you added: what the import measured (scale, channels, size step, output range, seconds per megapixel on this CPU).

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: Brush radius as a share of the image width.

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: Patches per step (lowered automatically if memory runs out).

patch.title: Patch
patch.description: Side of each low-resolution training patch, in pixels.

lr.title: Lr
lr.description: Peak learning rate (Adam), with warm-up and cosine decay.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: auto uses bfloat16 on GPUs that support it (RTX 30 and newer).

newer.title: Newer
newer.description: Releases newer than the running version, newest first.

current.description: Release notes for the running version, if published.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.description: True when this exact file was already in the library.
